_comment: Flood-sim config DRAFT schema (FLOOD_PLAN Phase 0). Ritter/Stoker 1D dam-break on a flat dry/wet bed — the first SWE validation case (Phase 10). Not yet consumed by the solver; the shallow_water solver (Phase 6) + flood.* RPC (Phase 9) will read this shape.

terrain._comment: Either an inline flat bed (here) or a DEM file. A real case uses {"asc": "path/to/dem.asc"} (Phase 1 reader) + crs.

crs._comment: Phase 2. For projected DEMs: shift to a local origin before meshing (f32 precision, FLOOD_PLAN §3).

initial._comment: Dam-break Riemann IC: still water, step in depth at x = dam_position.

boundaries._comment: Phase 7. xmin/xmax = transmissive (open) so the rarefaction/bore leave cleanly.

output._comment: Phase 9. VTK per interval; GeoTIFF unshifts the local origin back to the CRS.

validation._comment: Ritter (frictionless, dry bed) analytic: front celerity 2√(g·h_left), tip at x = dam + 2√(g·h_left)·t.
